extracted.intended_audience: public company management teams, investor relations professionals, corporate communications leaders
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance on corporate investor relations communications and outreach—how to craft and deliver messaging, prepare earnings processes, develop investor materials, target investors, and provide investor access.

rubrics_metrics.name: Articulate and communicate company's value creation story
rubrics_metrics.description: Leaders are judged by the value they create. We’ll help you articulate and communicate your company’s value creation story.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Focus communications on clear value-creation narratives that matter to stakeholders and investors. Use Wall Street-informed framing to highlight what drives long-term value.

rubrics_metrics.name: Strategic Messaging & Investment Positioning
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Develop investor-focused messaging and positioning that aligns corporate strategy with investor expectations and market language; leverage firsthand Wall Street expertise to shape how the investment community perceives the company.

rubrics_metrics.name: Quarterly Earnings Preparation & Process
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Establish disciplined processes to prepare for quarterly results and earnings calls; ensure executives and investor-facing teams are prepared to present results and answer investor/analyst questions consistently and effectively.

rubrics_metrics.name: Investor Materials Development
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Create and refine investor-facing materials (presentations, disclosures, summary materials) to communicate the investment thesis and key messages clearly to different investor constituencies.

rubrics_metrics.name: Corporate & Marketing Calendar
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Maintain coordinated calendars for corporate and marketing activities to optimize timing of announcements, events, roadshows, and investor communications.

rubrics_metrics.name: Institutional and Retail Investor Targeting & Engagement
rubrics_metrics.description: Institutional and Retail Investor Targeting & Engagement
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Segment and target both institutional and retail investor audiences; design tailored engagement strategies to reach and build relationships with each investor type.

rubrics_metrics.name: Market & Peer Intelligence
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Gather market and peer insights to inform messaging, positioning, and investor outreach; use competitive and market context to shape communications strategy.

rubrics_metrics.name: Sell-side Analyst Engagement
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Proactively engage sell-side analysts to influence coverage, provide context for performance and strategy, and ensure consistent understanding of the company among influential market commentators.

rubrics_metrics.name: IPO, M&A & Transaction Advisory
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide communications and advisory support for transactional events (IPOs, M&A, other corporate transactions) to manage investor expectations and regulatory/market messaging around deals.

rubrics_metrics.name: Perception Studies & Investor Days
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use perception studies and investor days to test and refine messaging, gather investor feedback, and create forums for deeper engagement with the investment community.

rubrics_metrics.name: IR Infrastructure & Best Practices
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Establish IR infrastructure and best practices to institutionalize investor communications, reporting cadence, governance, and cross-functional coordination.

rubrics_metrics.name: Investor Access: targeted outreach, data analysis, and information sharing
rubrics_metrics.description: ICR Investor Access creates direct connections between corporate management teams and investors. Through investor targeting, data analysis and information sharing services, we ensure all parties access necessary information up front and can build long-term, value-added relationships.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Prioritize data-driven targeting and transparent information sharing to enable direct management-investor interactions; ensure investors have necessary information up front to support long-term relationship building.

rubrics_metrics.name: ICR Conference participation for investor engagement
rubrics_metrics.description: 27th Annual ICR Conference — an invite-only event attended by 3000+ professionals, including institutional investors, private equity professionals, public and private companies, select media and equity research analysts.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Leverage large, curated conferences and invite-only events as channels to meet and engage a broad range of investors, analysts, and media; use presence at such events to amplify messaging and build relationships.
